description: Columbia University, Tel Aviv University and NYC Mesh publish OpenMesh, received-signal-level observations from more than 103 wireless links in New York City. The community communications network provides one-minute measurements intended for opportunistic urban weather sensing. Zenodo lists a public ZIP under CC-BY-4.0, free to reuse with attribution, and links the processing repository. The companion repository identifies October 2023–July 2024 coverage and paired personal-weather-station observations; internal file encoding remains unverified. It also cites the concept DOI alongside the inspected version DOI; these identify the same dataset family. Weather inference from signal attenuation requires attention to link geometry, radio behaviour and non-weather disruptions. These limitations matter when using the observations to calibrate rainfall sensing or communications-performance simulations. OpenMesh complements dedicated rain gauges with measurements from existing digital infrastructure. It is a dataset, not a live service guarantee, and the archive was not downloaded.
